Improved Wrath.sig: Reduces the cast time of your Wrath spell by # sec and its Mana cost by #%.

Genesis.sig: Increases the periodic damage and healing done by your spells and abilities by #%.

Moonglow.sig: Reduces the Mana cost of your damaging spells by #%.

Improved Moonfire.sig: Increases the damage and critical strike chance of your Moonfire spell by #%.

Nature's Majesty.sig: Increases your critical strike chance with spells and melee attacks by #%.

Nature's Reach.sig: Increases the range of your offensive Balance spells by #% and improves your chance to hit by #%.

Improved Entangling Roots.sig: Increases the damage done by your Entangling Roots spell by #%, and its victims can take up to #% more damage without interrupting the effect.

Nature's Splendor.sig: Increases the duration of your Moonfire and Rejuvenation spells by # sec, your Regrowth spell by # sec, and your Insect Swarm spell by # sec.

lines.t: damage over time that lowers the target's hit by {1}%

Insect Swarm.sig: The enemy target is swarmed by insects, decreasing their chance to hit with attacks by #% and causing # Nature damage over # sec.

Vengeance.sig: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Arcane and Nature spells by #%.

Improved Starfire.sig: Reduces the cast time of Starfire by # sec and Starfire has a #% chance to stun its target for # sec.

Overgrowth.sig: Increases the maximum number of targets you may have affected by Entangling Roots by #.

lines.t: spell crits speed up your next casts

Nature's Grace.sig: All non-periodic spell criticals grace you with a blessing of nature, increasing your spellcasting speed and reducing your global cooldown by #% for # sec.

Eclipse.sig: Your Wrath spell reduces the cast time of your next # Starfire spells by # sec. Stores up to # charges. Lasts # sec.

Moonfury.sig: Increases the damage done by your Arcane and Nature spells by #%.

lines.t: armor and +{4}% crit for your group

Moonkin Form.sig: Shapeshift into Moonkin Form, increasing Omen of Clarity's chance to trigger by #%, Armor contribution from items by #%, and all party or raid members within # yards have their Critical Strike chance increased by #%. Also protects the caster from Polymorph effects and prevents the use of healing spells. The act of shapeshifting frees the caster of Polymorph and Movement Impairing effects.

Ferocity.sig: Reduces the cost of your Maul, Primal Bite, Swipe, Claw, and Rake abilities by # Rage or Energy.

lines.t: {1}% chance for {2} rage when you shift in
keeps up to {3}% of your energy while you are out of cat

Furor.sig: Gives you a #% chance to gain # Rage when shapeshifting into Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. Shapeshifting into Cat Form restores #% of the Energy you had when last in Cat Form, plus # Energy per second spent outside Bear Form or Dire Bear Form, up to # Energy.

Feral Swiftness.sig: Increases your movement speed while in Cat Form by #%, and increases your chance to Dodge by #%.

Feral Instinct.sig: Increases damage done by your Swipe ability by #% and reduces the chance enemies have to detect you while Prowling as if you were # levels higher.

Brutal Impact.sig: Increases the stun duration of your Bash and Pounce abilities by # sec and reduces the cooldown of Bash by # sec.

Thick Hide.sig: While in Bear Form, Cat Form, Dire Bear Form, or Moonkin Form, you gain # additional base Armor per level and another # base Armor for each point of defense skill beyond five times your level. This amount can be further increased by multipliers from those forms.

Shredding Attacks.sig: Reduces the Energy cost of your Shred ability by # and reduces the Rage cost of your Lacerate ability by #.

Savage Fury.sig: Increases the damage caused by your Claw, Rake, Shred, Maul, and Swipe abilities by #%.

lines.t: bear charge that roots and interrupts, cat leap

Feral Charge.sig: Charge an enemy, immobilizing them and interrupting any spell they are casting for # sec. Feral Charge (Cat): #-# yd range, Instant, # sec cooldown, Requires Cat Form. Leap behind an enemy.

Sharpened Claws.sig: Increases your critical strike chance while in Bear Form, Dire Bear Form, or Cat Form by #%.

lines.t: +{1}% of your level as attack power

Predatory Strikes.sig: Increases your melee Attack Power in Cat Form, Bear Form, and Dire Bear Form by #% of your level.

lines.t: stacking bear bleed with high threat

Lacerate.sig: Lacerates the enemy target, making them bleed for # damage over # sec plus #% weapon damage per existing application of Lacerate on the target. Causes a high amount of threat. This effect stacks up to # times on the same target.

lines.t: spare energy adds damage without being spent

Predatory Discipline.sig: Your Ferocious Bite ability no longer converts extra Energy into damage, but still deals extra damage based on your excess Energy.

Blood Frenzy.sig: Gives you a #% chance to gain an additional # Rage any time you get a critical strike while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. In addition, your non-periodic critical strikes from Cat Form abilities that generate Combo Points have a #% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

lines.t: +{2}% crit for you and your party

Leader of the Pack.sig: While in Cat Form, Bear Form, or Dire Bear Form, the Leader of the Pack increases the Critical Strike chance of all party or raid members within # yards by #%.

Natural Instinct.sig: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your melee abilities by #% and increases your spell healing by #% of your Intellect.

Rend and Tear.sig: Increases damage done by your melee abilities on Bleeding targets by #%.

lines.t: {2}% chance for {3} rage when you dodge

Natural Reaction.sig: Increases your dodge chance by #%, and gives you a #% chance to gain # Rage each time you dodge.

lines.t: big bear bite with very high threat

Primal Bite.sig: Bite the target, dealing #% normal damage plus # and generating a high amount of threat.

Shifting Power.sig: Instantly convert #% of base Mana into # Energy. Shifting Power's cost is reduced by effects that reduce the cost of Shapeshifting.

lines.t: {1}% chance hits do not slow your casts

Nature's Focus.sig: Gives your Arcane and Nature spells a #% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

Heart of the Wild.sig: Increases your Intellect by #%. In addition, while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form your Stamina is increased by #% and while in Cat Form your Strength is increased by #%.

Naturalist.sig: Reduces the cast time of your Healing Touch and Wild Growth spells by # sec and increases all damage you deal by #%.

Reflection.sig: Allows #% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

Natural Shapeshifter.sig: Reduces the mana cost of all shapeshifting by #%.

Subtlety.sig: Reduces the threat generated by your Nature and Arcane spells by #%.

Gift of Nature.sig: Increases the effect of all your healing spells by #%.

lines.t: heal once more when they expire

Bloom.sig: When your Rejuvenation or Regrowth spell expires due to its duration, the target is instantly healed for an amount equal to #% of your Spirit. If either spell expires due to being dispelled, the target is healed for #% of your Spirit instead.

Tranquil Spirit.sig: Reduces the mana cost of your Healing Touch and Tranquility spells by #%.

Improved Rejuvenation.sig: Increases the effect of your Rejuvenation spell by #%.

lines.t: instant heal that eats a Rejuvenation or Regrowth

Swiftmend.sig: Instantly heals a target with your active Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect for an amount equal to the full duration of the periodic effect of the consumed spell.

Nature's Swiftness.sig: When activated, your next Nature spell becomes an instant cast spell.

Improved Tranquility.sig: Reduces threat caused by Tranquility by #% and its cooldown by #%.

Improved Regrowth.sig: Increases the critical effect chance of your Regrowth spell by #%.

Wild Growth.sig: Heals the target and their party for # over # sec. Party members must be within # yards of target. The amount healed is applied quickly at first, and slows down as Wild Growth reaches its full duration.

_spells.Barkskin: Reduces damage taken and stops hits from delaying your casts.
_spells.Entangling Roots: Roots the target in place. Damage can break it. Works indoors in Forever.
_spells.Faerie Fire: Lowers target armor and stops it from stealthing. Free in Cat and Bear Form in Forever.
_spells.Hibernate: Puts a beast or dragonkin to sleep. Damage wakes it.
_spells.Moonfire: Instant Arcane damage plus damage over time. Can crit.
_spells.Nature's Grasp: The next enemy that hits you in melee is rooted. Works indoors and in forms in Forever.
_spells.Omen of Clarity: Your attacks and spells can make your next ability free.
_spells.Soothe Animal: Shrinks the aggro range of a beast.
_spells.Starfire: Slow, heavy Arcane nuke. About 40% stronger in Forever.
_spells.Thorns: Damages melee attackers. Scales with spell power in Forever.
_spells.Wrath: Nature damage. Cheap in Forever, best as a pull.
_spells.Bash: Stuns the target and interrupts its spell. Brutal Impact shortens the cooldown.
_spells.Bear Form: More armor and health, uses rage. Entering it gives rage with Furor. Becomes Dire Bear Form at 40.
_spells.Cat Form: Uses energy and combo points. Learned through a quest at level 20.
_spells.Challenging Roar: Forces all nearby enemies to attack you for a few seconds.
_spells.Claw: Builder from any angle. Adds 1 combo point. 140% weapon damage in Forever.
_spells.Cower: Lowers your threat on the target.
_spells.Dash: Large burst of movement speed for a short time.
_spells.Demoralizing Roar: Lowers the attack power of nearby enemies.
_spells.Enrage: Gives 10 rage at once and more over 10 sec, but lowers your armor while active.
_spells.Ferocious Bite: Finisher. Hits harder with more combo points and spare energy.
_spells.Frenzied Regeneration: Turns rage into health over a few seconds.
_spells.Growl: Taunts the target to attack you.
_spells.Maul: Your next melee swing hits harder and causes extra threat.
_spells.Poised: Your next energy ability costs 10 less.
_spells.Pounce: Stuns the target and makes it bleed. Adds 1 combo point.
_spells.Prowl: Stealth. You move slower while prowling.
_spells.Rake: Bleed that adds 1 combo point. Works from Prowl.
_spells.Ravage: Big opener from behind. 435% weapon damage in Forever. Adds 1 combo point.
_spells.Rip: Finisher. Bleed that lasts longer with more combo points.
_spells.Shred: Builder from behind the target. Adds 1 combo point. 200% weapon damage in Forever.
_spells.Swipe: Hits up to 3 enemies in front of you.
_spells.Track Humanoids: Shows nearby humanoids on the minimap.
_spells.Abolish Poison: Removes one poison now and keeps removing poisons for 8 sec.
_spells.Gift of the Wild: Mark of the Wild on your whole party.
_spells.Innervate: Large mana regeneration on the target.
_spells.Mark of the Wild: Buff: armor, stats and resistances for 30 min.
_spells.Rebirth: Brings a dead ally back during combat. Needs a reagent.
_spells.Regrowth: Fast heal plus a heal over time. Cheaper in Forever.
_spells.Rejuvenation: Heal over time. Cheap and instant.
_spells.Revive: Brings a dead ally back out of combat.
_spells.Tranquility: Channeled heal on your whole party. Stand still while it runs.
_spells.Hurricane: Channeled storm on an area that slows attacks
_spells.Feline Grace: Passive: less falling damage in Cat Form
_spells.Insect Swarm: Nature damage over time that lowers the target's hit
_spells.Moonkin Form: Caster form with armor and group crit
_spells.Feral Charge: Bear charge that roots and interrupts, cat leap behind the target
_spells.Lacerate: Stacking bear bleed with high threat
_spells.Primal Bite: Big bear bite with very high threat, 6 sec cooldown
_spells.Shifting Power: Mana into 40 energy in Cat Form, 8 sec cooldown
_spells.Swiftmend: Instant heal that eats a Rejuvenation or Regrowth
_spells.Wild Growth: Heal over time on the target's whole party
